Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 4749 of 2024
Petitioner :- Smt. Reshma Bano

Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. Lko. And Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Arjun Kumar Kaushal

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Chaudhary,J.
Hon'ble Narendra Kumar Johari,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for petitioner and learned A.G.A. for the State, who has filed a counter
affidavit today, which is taken on record.

2.  By means of this petition, the petitioner has prayed for a mandamus commanding the opposite parties more specifically opposite party no.3 to take action against the opposite party nos.4 to 7 and to conclude the investigation of F.I.R. dated 25.5.2024 in Case Crime No.0073 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 & 506 I.P.C. and Sections 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station-Bhale Sultan Saheed Smarak, District-Amethi.
3. Learned A.G.A., on instructions, states that in this case, charge-sheet has been submitted before the supervisory authority on 25.7.2024.

sentences.text: In view thereof, if petitioner has any grievance in respect of charge-sheet, petitioner can express it by way of an application before the supervisory authority, who shall take a decision on the same in accordance with law within a period of four weeks from today.
5. With the aforesaid, the writ petition is disposed of.
